reviewer: Independent stats_util_review agent; implementation draft was authored by a previous agent.
scope: Read-only review of all 743 Native source lines and complete draft CPP/header; lower scientific and memory-owner interfaces checked where needed. No production edits, compilation, model runs or numerical claims in this review.

routine_contracts.name: stats_accumulate
routine_contracts.review: Leading scalar/grid/flags/parameter order and all fields match Native; only stats is mutated. Host sampled gate, conditional T/ice/cloud/shear diagnostics, zt/scalar/eddy/zm ordering, gamma lower calls, column maxima/cloud-base/water paths/vertical means, three normalized variations, physical-boundary spurious-source fluxes and sentinel paths reviewed.

routine_contracts.name: stats_accumulate_hydromet_api
routine_contracts.review: Sample gate, eight metadata-positive species updates, snow/ice/rain path guards, species indices and raw gr.dzt integral inputs match Native.

routine_contracts.name: stats_accumulate_lh_tend
routine_contracts.review: Sample gate; four thermodynamic/cloud tendencies, eight metadata-positive hydrometeor tendencies and seven Kessler fields preserve Native sequence and payloads.

independent_sequence_checks.method: A fresh balanced-parenthesis parser independently extracted all call first arguments after comment removal; Native scalar suffix concatenation was normalized to C++ syntax. All 102 names match in order. Public argument counts were separately parsed.

manual_checks: All scientific payloads matched by reading the Native and C++ call blocks, including passive/eddy subviews and hydrometeor metadata.
Native scalar/species/grid-bound metadata stays one-based; only array element selections subtract one. Explicit scalar stats column arguments use zero-based C++ loops.
Signed dzm/dzt in stats_accumulate and unsigned gr.dzt in hydrometeor paths preserve their distinct Native expressions.
Shear endpoints remain zero, cloud threshold comparisons and cloud-base last-level sentinel remain exact, and l_stability_correct_tau_zm gates only the same field update.

Normalized total variation keeps epsilon endpoint guard, -999 sentinel and each divided absolute difference inside its level sum. Increasing-level sum is the faithful initial translation; CPU numerical equivalence remains a whole-model gate.

Spurious-source eligibility preserves l_implemented or both all(abs(wm)<eps); host-applied surface fluxes become zero; physical top/surface indices, integral/flux argument order, -9999 excluded values and two output calls match.

Generic overloads stage only sampled timesteps and preserve every formal argument. Host scientific inputs are call-local copies and never overwritten. Shared to_host_space packs strided views before cross-space transfer.

Existing calc_wp3_on_wp2, temperature, saturation, zt2zm, skewness/gamma and ordered vertical profile helper owners remain visible lower calls; no Native fallback, new global model storage or new arithmetic workaround.

Routine order, meaningful scientific comments/dividers, argument grouping/intent comments and opening descriptions are coherent with Native. C++ templates and memory-stage adapters are documented language boundaries, not hidden field-specific algorithms.
limitations: The recorded Serial/CUDA object probes belong to the draft author and were inspected but not rerun by this reviewer.
A full-model CPU BFB comparison, file-byte equality, GPU checkpoint and final integration audit remain Root responsibilities; this source review does not establish them.
The permanent lower profile integral/average helpers use execution-space ordered kernels; no GPU numerical cause or performance analysis was done.
